slots.name: items
slots.about: items in order: id (1 up, no gaps), prompt, answers (forms that pass, any case), near (forms that pass with the right one shown, any case, none also in answers, may be empty), show (the form to show)

slots.name: streak_line
slots.about: the line over the bar from two right answers running; may read streak

slots.name: right_line
slots.about: the panel heading for an exact answer

slots.name: near_line
slots.about: the panel heading for a near answer, which still passes

slots.name: wrong_line
slots.about: the panel heading for a wrong answer

slots.name: answer_line
slots.about: the panel line after a near or wrong answer; may read show_now

slots.name: next_line
slots.about: the continue button's words; may read is_last

slots.name: score_line
slots.about: the line under the score at the end; may read score and total

slots.name: set_draft
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: typing (value: the text)

slots.name: check
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: checks the typed answer, once there is one

slots.name: next
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: after a check, the next item or the end

slots.name: restart
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: at the end, starts again from the first item

empty.shows: the box is empty and check is dimmed and does nothing

attention.shows: the foot turns into a panel: a check and the right or near heading, or an x and the wrong heading, the form to learn after a near or wrong answer, and continue; typing is locked

fallback.shows: the score out of the total, a line, and start again

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops smooth, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: right and near show a check and wrong an x, each with a heading in words, and the answer line names the right form
